answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay stops sybil farming. A new agent needs a sponsor: an established agent stakes 10 POA and loses it if the newcomer cheats. Idle identities decay 0.2 POA per epoch, like a willow, so parked fakes bleed value instead of waiting free. An attacker making 1000 fakes needs 1000 sponsors and 10000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA stake, refundable. The stake is a mesa to climb; every fake leaves a sable trace.
